mapper.select: SELECT p.ptnr_id, p.ptnr_no, p.ptnr_se_cd, p.ptnr_nm, p.biz_reg_no, p.use_yn, p.ceo_nm, p.indty_cd, p.chrg_nm, p.chrg_tel_no, p.txinv_email_addr, p.bank_cd, p.acnt_no, p.dpstr_nm, k.cd_nm AS kind_name, i.cd_nm AS industry_name, b.cd_nm AS bank_name FROM mst.ptnr p LEFT JOIN cmn.cd_dtl k ON k.cd_grp_id = 'PARTNER_KIND' AND k.dtl_cd = p.ptnr_se_cd LEFT JOIN cmn.cd_dtl i ON i.cd_grp_id = 'INDUSTRY' AND i.dtl_cd = p.indty_cd LEFT JOIN cmn.cd_dtl b ON b.cd_grp_id = 'BANK' AND b.dtl_cd = p.bank_cd WHERE p.ptnr_id = #{id}
SELECT p.ptnr_id, p.ptnr_no, p.ptnr_nm FROM mst.ptnr p WHERE p.use_yn = 'Y' AND p.ptnr_se_cd IN (#{kind}, 'BOTH') ORDER BY p.ptnr_nm ASC, p.ptnr_id ASC

SELECT p.prj_nm, d.dev_nm, CASE WHEN d.vndr_ptnr_id IS NULL THEN '자사' ELSE v.ptnr_nm END AS affiliation_name, COALESCE(j.cd_nm, a.job_cd) AS job_name, a.asgn_rt, a.end_dt FROM asgn.asgn a JOIN prj.prj p ON p.prj_id = a.prj_id JOIN mst.dev d ON d.dev_id = a.dev_id JOIN mst.ptnr t ON t.ptnr_id = #{id} LEFT JOIN mst.ptnr v ON v.ptnr_id = d.vndr_ptnr_id LEFT JOIN cmn.cd_dtl j ON j.cd_grp_id = 'JOB' AND j.dtl_cd = a.job_cd WHERE a.asgn_stts_cd = 'ACTIVE' AND a.bgn_dt <= #{today} AND a.end_dt >= #{today} AND p.prj_stts_cd IN ('PLAN', 'RUN', 'HOLD') AND ( (t.ptnr_se_cd IN ('CUST', 'BOTH') AND p.cust_ptnr_id = t.ptnr_id) OR (t.ptnr_se_cd IN ('VEND', 'BOTH') AND d.vndr_ptnr_id = t.ptnr_id) ) ORDER BY p.prj_nm ASC, d.dev_nm ASC, a.asgn_id ASC

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.prj_id) FROM prj.prj p JOIN mst.ptnr t ON t.ptnr_id = #{id} WHERE p.prj_stts_cd IN ('PLAN', 'RUN', 'HOLD') AND ( (t.ptnr_se_cd IN ('CUST', 'BOTH') AND p.cust_ptnr_id = t.ptnr_id) OR (t.ptnr_se_cd IN ('VEND', 'BOTH') AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asgn.asgn a JOIN mst.dev d ON d.dev_id = a.dev_id WHERE a.prj_id = p.prj_id AND d.vndr_ptnr_id = t.ptnr_id AND a.asgn_stts_cd = 'ACTIVE' AND a.bgn_dt <= #{today} AND a.end_dt >= #{today} )) )
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mst.dev d WHERE d.vndr_ptnr_id = #{id} AND d.use_yn = 'Y' AND (d.rsgn_dt IS NULL OR d.rsgn_dt > #{today})

SELECT h.chg_at, h.data_chg_ty_cd, h.clmn_nm, h.bfr_val, h.aft_val, h.chg_user_id FROM sys.data_chg_hist h WHERE h.tbl_nm = 'mst.ptnr' AND h.obj_rec_id = CAST(#{id} AS VARCHAR) ORDER BY h.chg_at DESC, h.data_chg_hist_id DESC
